title: pvCylinder
body:
## pvCylinder

Creates a cylinder as polydata with normals and texture coordinates: Resolution side facets, axis parallel to y, centred at Center, with both ends capped by default. Use it as reference geometry, e.g. a pipe or probe region. The orientation is fixed to y; rotate it with transform for other axes.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The axis is always y in this source; Center moves it but cannot tilt it.
- ParaView's default Resolution is 6; raise it for a round cross-section.
- Schemaxis generates this source from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for it, so inspect the output before relying on it.

Native constructor: `Cylinder`. Identity: `sources/CylinderSource`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Capping` | If this property is set to 1, the ends of the cylinder will each be capped with a closed polygon. Otherwise, the ends of the cylinder will be open. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Center` | This property specifies the coordinate value at the center of the cylinder. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `Height` | This property specifies the height of the cylinder (along the y axis). | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `Radius` | This property specifies the radius of the cylinder. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `Resolution` | This property indicates the number of divisions around the cylinder. The higher this number, the closer the polygonal approximation will come to representing a cylinder, and the more polygons it will contain. | `{"maximum":512,"minimum":2,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `2` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json

  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvCylinder"
}
```
